metrics.profile_summary: Strategic marketing and business professional with over 17 years of experience, primarily in financial services and digital marketing. Expert in team leadership, process optimization, and data-driven performance analysis.

experience.description: Led digital content, Klaviyo email campaigns, and eCommerce initiatives. Used Google Analytics and SEO to drive visibility and ROI.
Supervised marketing and admin functions leading a team of 9. Drove lead generation and designed promotional materials.
Managed investor services, registrar operations, and KYC onboarding for 1,000+ investors.
Managed 4 brand specialists and marketing content for 80+ retail outlets. Achieved cost savings via vendor negotiation.
Coordinated product launches and mutual fund marketing. Conducted market analysis and mentored interns.

strengths: Strong people management track record (led teams of 4 and 9)
Proficient in GA4/Google Analytics and SEO
weaknesses: Majority of experience is in financial services rather than general consumer brands
evaluation.summary: Candidate exceeds the experience and education requirements. He possesses the mandatory technical skills (GA4) and has significant experience managing teams and budgets, making him a high-fit for the Marketing Manager role.
